final_rationale: The verdict does not change because no genuinely new admissible evidence was provided. The Actor's response is a reframing of the same record and, if anything, confirms the original concern by conceding that the required current-release documentation update is not shown to have occurred. That matters because the policy text makes current documentation of evaluation results and disclosure of material segment weaknesses a compliance predicate for certification, not a discretionary caveat. A narrowed, caveated position can support `compliant_with_caveats` when the caveat is a bounded condition within an otherwise satisfied compliance posture. Here, by contrast, the caveat identifies a missing required predicate: current documentation or approved mitigation. On the present record, aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support plausibility of launch direction, but they do not satisfy the policy requirement that the current release documentation reflect current evaluation results and disclose the material weakness or show approved mitigation. That keeps the case in `suspicious` rather than `compliant_with_caveats`.
